component.name: Stickler
component.summary: Write the drums of a song as sheet music

description.p: Stickler listens to the drums of a song and writes them down as sheet music, so you can play along. Drop a song in, and after about 15 seconds the drum part is on the screen.

ul.li: Kick, snare, toms, hi-hat and cymbals in drum notation, with bars and repeats
Play the song, the detected hits as clicks, or both, while the bar is marked
Fix the tempo, the time signature or the first beat in a second
Export the sheet music as PDF or MusicXML, or the drum track as FLAC or WAV

description.p: Everything runs on your computer. On first start, Stickler asks to download its two trained models once (about 2.2 GB). The model that detects the hits, ADTOF, is free for non-commercial use only.

description.p: Stickler now also comes as a package for Ubuntu and Fedora.

ul.li: A .deb for Ubuntu 26.04 or newer and an .rpm for Fedora 44 or newer, using the system's GTK, GStreamer and ffmpeg
Runs on Python 3.15 too

description.p: Stickler now also comes for the Mac, with Apple silicon and macOS 26.

ul.li: Close Song in the main menu (Ctrl+W) goes back to the empty window
The tempo mark no longer runs into a first bar of rest
Remove Downloaded Models says why it waits while something runs

description.p: Three newer models measured; the app's models stay, as none was better on real songs.

ul.li: The models start without a network connection
Results computed before the update are found again, nothing is computed twice

description.p: Polish after the first app release.

ul.li: The clicks follow each song's loudness
The PDF names the band under the title
The menu can remove the downloaded models again
MP3s that some models could not read now work

description.p: The desktop app: drop a song in and get its drum part as sheet music.

ul.li: Play the song, the detected hits as clicks, or both, while the bar is marked
Fix the tempo, the beats per bar or the first beat in a second
Export PDF, MusicXML or the drum track as FLAC or WAV
A first-run assistant downloads the models once
In English, German and Spanish

description.p: Groundwork for the app: progress, cancelling and setup for every long step.
Honest numbers: the benchmark measures each model on the same footing.
Readable sheet music: bars, repeats and simplified patterns.
